title: 品格教育：反霸凌
footer: Teacher Dom · Character Education: Anti-Bullying 品格教育：反霸凌

slides.eyebrow_zh: 跟 Dom 老師上品格教育

strip.en: signs that tell bullying from a joke
strip.zh: 個訊號，分辨玩笑和霸凌

strip.en: sentences you can say to help

strip.zh: 個友善的邀請，就能改變一切

lines.en: This is my third year of teaching in Changhua.
lines.zh: 這是我在彰化教書的第三年。

lines.en: Today is not about grammar. It is about how we treat each other.
lines.zh: 今天不談文法，要談我們怎麼對待彼此。

slides.ask_en: Today: what bullying is, how to tell it from a joke, and what YOU can do.
slides.ask_zh: 今天要談：什麼是霸凌、怎麼分辨玩笑和霸凌，還有「你」可以做什麼。

slides.ask_en: Kids in California and kids in Xizhou want the same thing: to feel safe at school.
slides.ask_zh: 加州的孩子和溪州的孩子，想要的是同一件事：在學校感到安全。

prompts.en: Stand up if you have ever seen someone sitting alone at recess.
prompts.zh: 下課時看過有人自己一個人坐著的，站起來。

prompts.en: Stay standing if you wanted to help but did not know how.
prompts.zh: 想幫忙、卻不知道怎麼做的，繼續站著。

prompts.en: Stay standing if someone was once kind to YOU when you felt left out.
prompts.zh: 自己被冷落時，曾經有人對你好的，繼續站著。

slides.punch_en: Wanting to help is the first step. Today we learn the next ones.
slides.punch_zh: 想幫忙，就是第一步。今天我們來學接下來的幾步。

slides.body_en: Bullying is hurting someone on purpose, usually again and again, when they cannot easily make it stop. It can be hitting, mean words, leaving someone out, or messages online.
slides.body_zh: 霸凌是故意傷害別人，而且通常一再發生，對方很難讓它停下來。它可以是動手、說難聽的話、排擠別人，或是網路上的訊息。

slides.note_en: Ask three things: Is everyone laughing? Does it stop? Does it keep coming back?
slides.note_zh: 問三件事：大家都在笑嗎？說停會停嗎？會不會一直再來？

slides.head_en: If 30 students from around the world were one class…
slides.head_zh: 如果把全世界的學生縮成一個 30 人的班…
slides.reveal_en: About 1 in 3 was bullied at school in the past month.
slides.reveal_zh: 大約每 3 個就有 1 個，上個月在學校被霸凌過。

slides.q_en: Which of these is ALSO bullying?

options.en: Leaving someone out on purpose, every day
options.zh: 每天故意不讓某個人加入

slides.explain_en: Bullying is not only hitting. Being left out on purpose, again and again, hurts just as much.
slides.explain_zh: 霸凌不只是動手。一次又一次被故意排擠，一樣很痛。

slides.head_zh: 旁觀者，還是挺身而出的人？
slides.body_en: A bystander sees bullying and does nothing. An upstander does something: stand next to the person, say “Stop, that's not OK,” or tell a teacher. You don't have to be brave alone.
slides.body_zh: 旁觀者看到霸凌，什麼都不做。挺身而出的人會採取行動：站到對方身邊、說「停，這樣不對」，或去告訴老師。你不需要一個人勇敢。

slides.q_en: A classmate sits alone at every recess. What is the best FIRST step?
slides.q_zh: 有個同學每節下課都自己坐著。最好的「第一步」是什麼？
slides.explain_en: Sit nearby and listen. A calm, caring moment helps someone feel seen and safe.
slides.explain_zh: 坐到旁邊，用心聽。一段平靜溫暖的陪伴，讓人感到被看見、很安心。

slides.head_zh: 真的還假的？手比 ⭕ 或 ❌

items.en: If I only watch, I am not part of it.
items.zh: 我只是在旁邊看，就不關我的事。
items.note_en: Silence tells the bully it is OK.
items.note_zh: 沉默等於告訴霸凌的人：這樣沒關係。

items.en: Telling a teacher is the same as tattling.
items.zh: 告訴老師就是打小報告。
items.note_en: Tattling gets someone in trouble. Reporting keeps someone safe.
items.note_zh: 打小報告是要讓人被罵；報告是要讓人安全。

items.en: Mean messages online are real bullying.
items.zh: 網路上的難聽話，是真的霸凌。
items.note_en: Words on a screen hurt just as much — and they stay.
items.note_zh: 螢幕上的字一樣傷人，而且會一直留著。

items.zh: 霸凌別人的人，是可以改變的。
items.note_en: Kindness is a skill. Everyone can learn it.
items.note_zh: 善良是一種能力，每個人都學得會。

slides.rule_en: In 30 seconds, shout out as many KIND words as you can — in English. I will count!
slides.rule_zh: 30 秒內，用英文喊出越多「善良的字」越好，我來數！

slides.prompt_en: Tell your partner about a time someone was kind to you when you needed it.
slides.prompt_zh: 告訴你的同學：有一次你很需要的時候，有人對你很好。
slides.time_en: One minute each. Then I will ask two of you.
slides.time_zh: 每人一分鐘。然後我會請兩位分享。

lines.en: We notice when someone is left out.
lines.zh: 有人被冷落，我們會注意到。

lines.en: We invite — we do not exclude.
We tell an adult when someone is hurt.
lines.zh: 有人受傷，我們會告訴大人。

slides.tip_en: Read it out loud together — then seal it with a high five!
slides.tip_zh: 一起大聲唸出來——然後擊掌為約！

slides.note_en: Watch for the open hand — what does it mean?
slides.note_zh: 注意看那隻伸出來的手——它代表什麼？

slides.head_en: 3 Things You Can Do This Week
slides.head_zh: 這週你可以做的 3 件事

items.en: Notice: look for someone who is alone.
items.zh: 注意：看看有沒有人落單。

items.en: Invite: ask them to join your game.
items.zh: 邀請：請他加入你們的遊戲。

items.en: Report: if someone is being hurt, tell a teacher.
items.zh: 報告：有人被傷害，就告訴老師。

slides.q_en: In the USA, October is a special month. What is it for?
slides.q_zh: 在美國，十月是一個特別的月份。它是什麼月？
slides.explain_en: October is National Bullying Prevention Month. On Unity Day — October 21 this year — students wear orange to say: everyone belongs.
slides.explain_zh: 十月是美國的全國反霸凌月。在「團結日」（今年是 10 月 21 日），學生會穿橘色衣服，表示：每個人都屬於這裡。

slides.body_en: Go to our School Tour page and find the Chengkung Elementary column. No sign-up, no login — tell me one kind thing you will do this week.
slides.body_zh: 到我們網站的 School Tour 頁面，找到成功國小那一欄，免註冊、免登入，告訴我這週你會做的一件善良的事。

slides.big_zh:
要善良、要勇敢。
每個人都屬於這裡。
slides.sign_en: See you after the break, Chengkung!
